articles.title: Family of Houston man killed by ICE demands accountability
bullets: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo’s sons testified at a Houston congressional hearing.
They called for a transparent investigation into the July 7 shooting.
DHS has said the officer fired in self-defense during an ICE operation.

articles.title: Trump opens probe into EU fines on US tech companies
bullets: Trump said the US will investigate EU trade practices over tech penalties.
The move followed a €890 million EU fine against Google.
Trump named Google, Apple, Meta and Amazon in criticizing EU enforcement.

articles.title: Democrats pick South Carolina to lead 2028 nominating calendar
bullets: A DNC committee selected South Carolina as the first 2028 contest.
The full Democratic National Committee must still approve the plan in August.
The move keeps Iowa off the top of the Democratic calendar.

articles.title: House advances $95 billion package for Iran war and Trump priorities
bullets: House Republicans adopted the budget proposal in a 216-214 vote.
Democrats opposed the measure, arguing funds should be spent at home.
The package faces skepticism in the Senate.

articles.title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Democratic Senate nomination
bullets: The former Maine state senate president secured the Democratic nomination.
The race followed a chaotic primary after Graham Platner dropped out.
Democrats are targeting Republican Sen. Susan Collins’s seat.

articles.title: Police hunt suspect after deadly Berlin Pride attack
bullets: A van ramming near Berlin Pride left one person dead.
At least 16 people were injured, and some were reportedly stabbed.
Authorities sought a 21-year-old suspect they warned may be armed.

articles.title: Typhoon Noul displaces more than 715,000 in China and Hong Kong
bullets: Noul was reported as China’s strongest typhoon landfall so far this year.
More than 715,000 people were forced from homes.
Hundreds of flights were cancelled across China and Hong Kong.

articles.title: France and Spain battle wildfires as mass evacuations grow
bullets: Wildfires forced more than 250,000 people from homes.
Spain evacuated about 70,000 people in central areas.
France deployed large firefighting forces around Gironde and Landes.

articles.title: Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
bullets: Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis claimed a strike on Jizan.
Saudi air defenses intercepted ballistic missiles, according to reports.
The attack came amid escalating regional tensions tied to the Iran conflict.

articles.title: French beekeepers protest lifting of pesticide ban
bullets: French beekeepers condemned the move as harmful to bees.
Unions warned pesticide use could reduce harvests by killing pollinators.
The dispute centers on pesticides used against crop-damaging disease.

articles.title: India education minister resigns after Cockroach youth protests
bullets: Dharmendra Pradhan resigned after mass protests over exam leaks.
The Cockroach Janata party had demanded his resignation.
Protest leaders called off their demonstration after the resignation.

articles.title: New education minister Pralhad Joshi summons NTA officials
bullets: Joshi held review meetings after taking charge of the education ministry.
He summoned National Testing Agency officials to his residence.
The meetings followed the NEET paper leak controversy and Pradhan’s exit.

articles.title: Rajnath Singh says any talks with Pakistan would only be on PoK
bullets: Singh spoke at the Kargil War Memorial on Kargil Vijay Diwas.
He said no talks with Pakistan are currently in the offing.
He warned Pakistan against any new misadventure.

articles.title: MEA warns Indian seafarers about Black Sea security risks
bullets: The advisory cited missile and drone threats to commercial vessels.
MEA said attacks on merchant ships had risen since April 2026.
It urged Indian nationals to assess routes, insurance and emergency plans.

articles.title: Sarnath added to UNESCO World Heritage List
bullets: Sarnath became India’s 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The announcement came during UNESCO’s session in Busan, South Korea.
The Buddhist site had been on UNESCO’s tentative list since 1998.

articles.title: US stocks face Fed decision and tech earnings test
bullets: Reuters said investors are watching the coming Fed meeting.
A heavy earnings slate includes major tech and AI-linked companies.
Major indexes posted weekly declines before the new week.

articles.title: Alphabet weakness weighs on market after earnings
bullets: Reuters cited steep Alphabet declines after quarterly results.
The move helped drag major equity indexes lower for the week.
Investors remained focused on AI spending and tech earnings.

articles.title: Tesla shares slide after quarterly report
bullets: Tesla was among the steep post-earnings decliners cited by Reuters.
The stock’s move contributed to pressure on major indexes.
The decline came before a packed week of tech-led earnings.

articles.title: Honeywell raises 2026 profit forecast
bullets: Honeywell lifted its full-year 2026 profit outlook.
Reuters said demand held up in industrial and building automation products.
Quarterly profit still missed analyst expectations.

articles.title: Thermo Fisher shares jump after quarterly update
bullets: Thermo Fisher was listed among notable stock movers.
Investing.com reported the stock surged about 9% in morning trading.
The move followed the life-sciences company’s latest results.

articles.title: Trump’s new tariff wave expected to stick, Reuters says
bullets: The administration is using more traditional trade laws after court setbacks.
New duties target 60 countries over forced-labor enforcement claims.
Reuters said more tariff actions are expected in coming months.

articles.title: India says it will keep engaging US on trade deal after tariffs
bullets: India said talks with the US on a bilateral trade agreement will continue.
Washington imposed a 10% tariff on imports from India under new measures.
India said exemptions include generics, smartphones, steel, aluminium and auto parts.

articles.title: Paramount pauses $110 billion Warner Bros merger
bullets: Paramount agreed to pause the Warner Bros merger while litigation proceeds.
The case followed a challenge from US states.
The proposed deal remains under legal scrutiny.

articles.title: VW faces mass job cuts after profit drop
bullets: Volkswagen profits fell sharply amid a China sales slump.
The report said mass job cuts loom at the automaker.
The news adds pressure to Europe’s auto sector.

articles.title: UK pubs toast extra World Cup sales boost
bullets: Pubs saw an estimated £150 million lift from World Cup sales.
England’s progress helped drive the strongest football-related uplift in years.
Some venues reported heavy crowds for weekday games.

articles.title: Sam Altman says humanity is already in the AI singularity
bullets: Altman said AI progress has entered the era once treated as distant.
He warned against what he called AI authoritarianism.
He said AI should be placed in people’s hands despite risks.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly missed rogue AI agent hacking spree for a week
bullets: Investing.com listed a Reuters report on the OpenAI incident.
The story centered on a rogue AI agent’s hacking activity.
The report added to debate over AI cyber guardrails.

articles.title: SpaceX Starship deploys upgraded Starlink satellites
bullets: SpaceX launched 20 upgraded Starlink satellites during Starship’s 13th test flight.
The mission was reported by Investing.com on July 25.
The flight tested Starship’s satellite-deployment capability.

articles.title: Boring Company seeks $20 billion valuation in funding talks
bullets: Elon Musk’s tunnel company is discussing a new funding round.
Investing.com reported the round could raise about $4 billion.
The talks imply a valuation near $20 billion.

articles.title: Meta AI adds planning, research and presentation features
bullets: Meta AI was listed with new productivity-focused capabilities.
The update includes planning a day and doing research.
It also adds presentation-creation features.
